issues.description: Return type mismatch for Milkable.messageOnMilk(): The problem statement's UML and text declare messageOnMilk() as returning a String (problem_statement.md lines 51-53 and the textual requirement at line 93: the method should return "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). In the solution, the Milkable interface declares messageOnMilk() returning boolean (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Milkable.java line 5) and the Goat and Seal classes implement it with signature 'public boolean messageOnMilk()' (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Goat.java line 15 and solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Seal.java line 19), printing the message and returning true. This discrepancy confuses students: following the exercise (String-returning method) leads to a type mismatch with the provided solution and inconsistent usage in example code that prints the method result.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement: change the Milkable interface to 'String messageOnMilk();' and update Goat and Seal to return the formatted string (e.g. 'return "Goat " + getName() + " is milked";') instead of printing and returning boolean. Update any call sites (Main or tests) to print the returned String. If the intended design was boolean, update the UML and problem text to state the boolean return and that implementations print the message and return success, keeping the wording consistent.
